notes.title: Jock Studio Demo 2.1 - Available Now!
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44357986/b5da55ea77124eacf92335d67629bf633cd1cdca.jpg[/img]

Olympians, it’s an exciting day – [b]Jock Studio Demo 2.1 is now available for download![/b] Our team has worked very hard to provide this [b]optimized version of Jock Studio Demo 2,[/b] and we hope that the experience is much smoother and manageable for everyone who plays! Check out everything that’s changed at [b]the patch notes[/b] below, as well as[b] read the full post for the highlights![/b]

[url=https://www.blitsgames.com/bugreport/]https://www.blitsgames.com/bugreport/[/url]

[h1]Jock Studio Demo 2.1 – What’s Changed?[/h1]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44357986/01c1ea6ca9b44d6478327717103c661f53603090.jpg[/img]

[b]Jock Studio Demo 2.1[/b] is the [b]optimized version of Jock Studio Demo 2.0[/b], which was released in [b]a Beta Version last December 2024[/b]. Since then, our programming team has been hard at work resolving the bugs and issues encountered in that Beta Version, as well as performing several upgrades and overhauls to the full game itself. 

While there isn’t [b]any new content in version 2.1[/b], several [b]new features[/b] are available for the first time – check them out below!

[h2]Demo 1 & 2 – Together at Last! [/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44357986/4dc0849ad0367b2a4598c2b7cb8bfc2935cbbd2b.jpg[/img]

Like we previewed earlier this year, [b]Jock Studio Demo 2.1 merges both Demo 1 and Demo 2.0 into one playable demo[/b], making it much easier to play both versions without needing two separate downloads! When you click ‘New Game’ from the main menu, you will be presented with an option to [b]choose either Demo 1.0 or Demo 2.0[/b], and can play either right from the start! 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44357986/d0dd67f5e5fd76703307a5883afee9ba9e6ef7b5.png[/img]

As a reminder for everyone, [b]Demo 1[/b] features the introduction of the game’s cast and premise in [b]a Visual Novel / Story format[/b], while [b]Demo 2[/b] features most of the core mechanics and gameplay loop of Jock Studio in a [b]Dating Simulator format.[/b] We highly recommend playing Demo 1 prior to playing Demo 2 if it’s your first time!

[u][i]PS – Please note your progress does not carry over between Demos. Both Demos function independently from one another. [/i][/u]

Not only that, but [b]Demo 1.0’s images[/b] have been added to [b]the Gallery App[/b], so you can view all images after you’ve encountered them in game again, including [b]with animation![/b]

[h2]New Sex Scene Animations[/h2]

Speaking of animations, like we previewed earlier this year, [b]all six of the Filming Club Sex Scenes have now been fully animated[/b], and can be experienced in [b]both the game’s story and the Gallery App![/b] Enjoy these spicy new animations, giving the scenes a whole new level of life!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44357986/236be7602efc2783f6414125db4d8d32c843b98e.png[/img]

[h2]Music App Now Available![/h2]

Another feature enabled in Demo 2.1 is [b]the Music App[/b] – a chill spot where you can [b]listen to the game’s various different soundtracks[/b] with ease, organizing them by favorites, looping them and more, just like in traditional music apps! Enjoy jamming out to some tunes when you’re not out exploring the campus, Olympians!

[u][i]PS – Until the game’s official release, the music app will be the only way to listen to Jock Studio’s soundtrack. Jock Studio’s OST will be available on Streaming Platforms after the game’s full release.[/i][/u]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44357986/547c66c1261d6af1dd1d4fa82f6915c72fe053cd.png[/img]

[h2]Tutorial Hub Overhaul[/h2]

Finally, we received a great deal of feedback regarding [b]the in-game tutorials[/b], and have done a complete overhaul of[b] the Tutorial System! [/b]The game’s tutorials should be much easier to read and understand, and not only that, but you can also check a newly added [b]‘skip tutorials’ button inside of the game’s settings[/b], allowing you to bypass all tutorials on subsequent playthroughs!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44357986/20f565fd7ffcbcf9596cc2aa3fb881ac3462ae59.png[/img]

[h1]Demo 2.1 Download Links[/h1]

That’s all for [b]Demo 2.1[/b], but we hope everyone enjoys this newly updated and optimized version! [u][b]Demo 2.1 is available now for free for PC and Mac, and can be downloaded on our website, Itch.io, or Steam![/b][/u] Click the link below for your copy:

[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2115310/Jock_Studio/]https://store.steampowered.com/app/2115310/Jock_Studio/[/url]

If you enjoy [b]Demo 2.1[/b] and want to support Jock Studio’s development, [u][b]please consider pre-ordering your copy of the game at the links below[/b][/u] – any pre-orders will receive their copy of the full game on release automatically via our various different distributions. Thank you for your support!

[url=https://www.blitsgames.com/product/jock-studio-pre-order/]https://www.blitsgames.com/product/jock-studio-pre-order/[/url]

[url=https://blitsgames.itch.io/jock-studio ]https://blitsgames.itch.io/jock-studio [/url]

[u][i]PS – Please note that Demo 2.1 is not currently available for Android devices. Our team is still assessing the viability of an android build of Jock Studio, and will inform everyone if it becomes available. Thank you for understanding.[/i][/u]

[h1]Closing Word[/h1]

Thank you for your patience with us while we worked on this exciting update for Jock Studio! Our programmers have done a ton of work to get this version out to you all, and we hope that all the work put in will also translate over to the full game as well! 

That’s all for now, but we’ll be back with [b]a Development Diary at the end of May 2025[/b], so please stay tuned for more exciting development news then! 

Thank you again for your support, Olympians!

Lots of love,
~BLits Games

notes.title: Jock Studio Kickstarter & Demo Launched!
notes.notes:
Welcome, freshmen! The long wait is over, and the day is finally here! 

The [b]Jock Studio Kickstarter Campaign and Free Demo[/b] have launched. Check them out now at the link below:

[url=https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/blitsgames/jock-studio?ref=8to07c]https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/blitsgames/jock-studio?ref=8to07c[/url]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44357986/24f735fe078d5edc8c693e9700caa077cf64e130.png[/img]

[h2]Kickstarter Campaign[/h2]

After much planning and discussion with the team and considering the recent fan survey results, we have crafted a highly customized campaign for Jock Studio to launch on Kickstarter!

We have all kinds of new and exciting information on the page, including the game, story, characters, artwork, voice snippets, music samples, and more! 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44357986/f7a6e49c83afdb81d601b9cb050ab9224eb99b81.png[/img]

On our Kickstarter campaign, we’ve created a wide variety of [b]reward tiers[/b] with exclusive benefits and limited-edition merchandise that you can select depending on your pledge amount and reward preferences! You can find sample mock-ups and check out all the planned Jock Studio merch items!

We’ve also included a milestone campaign for [b]stretch goals[/b] based on the total pledges collected, allowing the dev team to gain more resources to make Jock Studio a bigger game, as we envisioned! We hope to reach these goals with you!

[i]Please note that all monetary values of the funding goal and stretch goals do not fully represent the project cost and expenses.[/i]

Click the link below to visit the Kickstarter now, and be sure to pledge between today and when the [b]campaign ends, 30 days from now on August 10th, 2023, at 9:00 AM EDT![/b]

[url=https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/blitsgames/jock-studio?ref=8to07c]https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/blitsgames/jock-studio?ref=8to07c[/url]

For questions, inquiries, and other concerns about our campaign, visit our [b]Kickstarter FAQs, Updates, and Comments tab![/b]

[h2]Jock Studio Free Demo[/h2]

We’re also happy to announce the complete release of the Jock Studio Demo in celebration of our Kickstarter Campaign launch!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44357986/71305748706a213baf875cf1b586daecfd5b506c.png[/img]

As previously announced, this demo contains a fully-playable prologue of the game introducing the premise, story, characters, and settings of Jock Studio! The demo features the following:
- Six unique playable character routes 
- Captivating storyline and character designs
- Expressive hand-drawn character sprites
- Highly custom, hand-drawn cutscene art
- Fully animated, uncensored erotic scenes
- Immersive, custom background art
- Fully-voiced cutscenes and partial voice acting
- Custom-designed user interface powered by Unity and NaniNovel
- Original soundtrack feat. Goomin Nam, HMNK, OtoKin & AdlibPiano

Please note that this does not represent the entire gameplay and is only meant to showcase the project concept. The full game will have a playable day and time schedule, an interactable campus map, an affection point system, mini-games, and more!

You can [b]download the demo, [/b]available for Steam, PC, and Mac, directly from our Kickstarter Page – with our quick link below:

[url=https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/blitsgames/jock-studio?ref=8to07c]https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/blitsgames/jock-studio?ref=8to07c[/url]

For questions related to the latest Jock Studio Demo, you may contact us via email: [url=info@blitsgames.com]info@blitsgames.com[/url] or post on our Kickstarter comments section and we’ll respond to you as soon as we can!

You may also report a bug on the latest Jock Studio Demo using this link: [url=https://www.blitsgames.com/bugreport/ ]https://www.blitsgames.com/bugreport/ [/url]

[h2]Closing Note[/h2]

We hope everyone enjoys the content our team has been working so hard for over the last eight months since we first announced the project! We wanted the demo to be free for all our fans, and we hope you can support us in the Kickstarter campaign through your pledges so that our team can develop this project to the best version it can be! As always, we appreciate everyone’s patience, support, and understanding throughout the years, and we look forward to providing nothing but our best efforts to deliver a quality BL game for all of us to enjoy!

Don’t forget to subscribe to our website newsletter, follow our social media accounts, or join our Discord community for more updates to come!
